# Runtime Zero execution routing

For work in runtime-zero, read [the project execution contract](../../runtime-zero/AGENTS.md) and [the startup orders](../../runtime-zero/START_HERE.md), then use [the project backlog](../../runtime-zero/backlog/backlog.json). Install missing required tools on the user's local machine under the setup runbook. Implement one dependency-eligible task, verify it, and record evidence. This rule is scoped to the RPG and does not change sibling games. If instruction discovery is unavailable, attach the two entry documents explicitly.

Before choosing each RPG task, follow [the review protocol](../../runtime-zero/reviews/README.md) and run `node tools/reviews.js --next` from runtime-zero. Respond to review requests automatically within the active session; only the validator accepts submissions.
